x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

min_rem = 1 << 32
best_num = 1 << 32
best_den = 1 << 32

for denom in range(1, n + 1):
    numerator = max(x * denom // y - 10, 0)
    for delta in range(20):
        diff = abs(x * denom - (numerator + delta) * y)
        if min_rem * denom > diff * best_den:
            min_rem = diff
            best_num = numerator + delta
            best_den = denom
        elif min_rem * denom == diff * best_den:
            if best_den > denom or (best_den == denom and best_num > numerator + delta):
                min_rem = diff
                best_num = numerator + delta
                best_den = denom

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
